images.name: overview
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: README editorial illustration for ZooRadar, OpenZoo's reading site covering AI, robotics, animal behavior, human cognition, paleontology, ecology and evolution.
Style/medium: Sophisticated flat editorial illustration with gently rounded geometric forms, dark plum fine outlines, layered cut-paper shapes, very subtle paper grain, no photorealism. Cheerful yet thoughtful scientific magazine mood; uncluttered and crisp at small sizes. Color palette exactly warm ivory #fff9f1 background, deep violet #7040b7, pale lavender #ded0ff, mint #9bdfc2, butter yellow #ffe18c, dark plum #292435, small peach accents #ffc7b1. Landscape 16:9, full composition with generous whitespace and margins, solid ivory edge. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no border. Avoid futuristic neon, busy collage, cartoon faces, humanoid savior imagery, humans, fake website screenshots.
Primary request: Create the opening illustration, an elegant observation desk connecting robotics and the living world through source reading.
Composition: one coherent central scene. A simple rounded two-legged research robot in violet on the left, a mint-green songbird perched on a branch on the right, with a subtle pale ammonite fossil shape and leaf below. At center an open cream research folio with a few abstract purple lines and blank paper cards, no actual text. A gentle violet observation arc/radar-like arc connects robot, folio and bird, expressing tracking and curiosity. Small minimal dot accents; foreground objects grounded in subtle flat shadows. The robot and bird are similarly sized and equally important. Biological subjects do not look mechanical. This is a conceptual illustration, not a screenshot or factual diagram.

Composition: a horizontal cut-paper desk scene with three spacious groups. A single thin violet flowing line visually connects these groups from left to right. Tiny butter-yellow paper clips and restrained dots. No verification ticks, seals, shields or claims of human review. No machinery and no characters. Match reference palette, paper texture, flat shapes, subtle layered shading, stroke softness and ivory canvas exactly.
